# org.modkitx.blizzard/models (MK2 → MK3, generated)

<!-- @generated by scripts/convert-mk2.mjs; re-run `pnpm convert:mk2` instead of editing. -->

Mechanically converted contribution envelopes for the v1 codecs of this MK2 extension.
The manifests are complete MK3 data. A module under `src/` marked `port-pending` below
implements `probe` only and throws `x3.mk2/port-pending` from `open`; one marked `ported`
is hand-written, owned by a human, and never regenerated.

The conversion debt of every codec below — planes v2 has no home for, applied
renames, converter defaults and v1 operations left without a handler — is data in
`MK2-CONVERSION.json` beside this file.

| contribution     | v1 manifest                                                     | module            | port   |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | ------ |
| `org.modkitx/m3` | `extensions/blizzard/starcraft-2/codecs/m3/codec.manifest.json` | `src/m3/codec.js` | ported |

## Signatures added at port time

The v1 manifests of these codecs carried no magic — they routed on a path glob
matching every file, which MK3 does not accept as a wildcard. Their
`match.signatures` come from the container specifications, not from MK2:

- `org.modkitx/m3` — `3333444d` @0, `3433444d` @0. Source: Blizzard M3 container header: reversed little-endian MD33 / MD34 tags at byte zero (M3_FILE_FORMAT_SPECIFICATION, header and index table).
